name: Lyra Shatel
source:
A confident, cocky and slightly obnoxious girl. She's impulsive, thrill seeking and her outspokenness and general lack of media training has caused several issues for Hopes Peak the the Funny how she was completely onboard with the Anti-Ultimate movement and publicly advocated for it in debates until she became Hope's Peak's little cash cow.

Initially growing fame for her incredibly strong debates which contained impressive amounts of wider worldly knowledge for a highschool student she's grown a bit of a cult following, She seems to be decisive amongst prisoners. It's unclear if she's useful to the group or actively causing issues.

When interrogated about her crime she seemed to be amused, but there was a much darker look in her eyes and I could see she was twitching and shaking under the table. Coward.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Lyra_Shatel_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]Wiki[/url]]
